current_point.claim: 提出一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要压缩图快照、图自编码器训练节点表征并结合循环神经网络学习时序依赖，实现高效生成大规模时序图的高质量表征。
current_point.claim_en: Propose a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which compresses graph snapshots via graph summarization, trains node representations with a graph autoencoder, and integrates a recurrent neural network to learn temporal dependencies, efficiently generating high-quality representations of large-scale sequential graphs.
source_locations: 论文摘要中关于GSAERU模型的段落
论文英文摘要中关于GSAERU模型的段落
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
通过图摘要技术对原图进行压缩
将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用重构误差训练原图节点表征
通过循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Model dynamic sequential graph as a sequence of snapshots at each time step
Compress the original graph via graph summarization technology
Input the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder and train representations of original nodes using reconstruction error
Learn temporal feature information and dependencies via a recurrent neural network
